Name: Sleepy Eye
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: Buy a reusable tent to sleep anywhere!
Description:
**Sleepy Eye** lets you buy a reusable tent to sleep anywhere!

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io) and [SpaceCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**
Sleep here. Sleep there. Sleep everywhere!

You can buy the tent from Pierre's shop for 5000g. Select it in your toolbar and **hold** left-click for seven seconds (configurable) to go to sleep.

**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

**See also**

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/SleepyEye/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods)
